name: Permission allowlists to cut prompts
summary: Allow rules that cut permission prompts. Rejected: auto mode is already the starting mode for interactive terminal and VS Code sessions, and allow rules widen the attack surface. v8 writes no permission rules by default; bench fingerprints record the permission mode.

evidence.effect: Auto mode is the starting mode for interactive terminal and VS Code sessions
Interactive sessions on third-party providers or with telemetry off start in auto mode when no mode is set

revisit: auto mode stops being the default
maintenance: Native Claude Code setting; watch the permission-mode docs.
